/* selectMonstersByFamilyId - 몬스터 상세용 패밀리 전체 (목록 API와 별도) */ SELECT m.monster_id , m.kr_name , m.un_name , m.monster_elemental , m.image_url , CAST(m.star AS INTEGER) AS star , m.archetype , m.arousal_type , CAST(m.family_id AS INTEGER) AS family_id FROM monster m WHERE m.family_id IS NOT NULL AND CAST(m.family_id AS BIGINT) = CAST(#{family_id} AS BIGINT) AND m.usg_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY m.monster_elemental, m.monster_id

/* selectMonstersByUnName - family_id 없을 때 un_name으로 패밀리 보완 (대소문자 무시: ILIKE) */ SELECT m.monster_id , m.kr_name , m.un_name , m.monster_elemental , m.image_url , CAST(m.star AS INTEGER) AS star , m.archetype , m.arousal_type , CAST(m.family_id AS INTEGER) AS family_id FROM monster m WHERE m.un_name IS NOT NULL AND m.un_name ILIKE #{un_name} AND m.usg_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY m.monster_elemental, m.monster_id

/* selectMonstersByEvolutionGroupKey - MonsterIdEvolutionUtil.evolutionGroupKey 와 동일 조건 */ SELECT m.monster_id , m.kr_name , m.un_name , m.monster_elemental , m.image_url , CAST(m.star AS INTEGER) AS star , m.archetype , m.arousal_type , CAST(m.family_id AS INTEGER) AS family_id FROM monster m WHERE COALESCE(m.usg_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' AND LENGTH(m.monster_id) >= 2 AND ( SUBSTRING(m.monster_id FROM 1 FOR LENGTH(m.monster_id) - 2) || SUBSTRING(m.monster_id FROM LENGTH(m.monster_id) FOR 1) ) = #{evolution_group_key} ORDER BY m.monster_elemental, m.monster_id

/* selectMonstersBySkillGroupId - 같은 스킬 그룹(다른 속성 패밀리) */ SELECT m.monster_id , m.kr_name , m.un_name , m.monster_elemental , m.image_url , CAST(m.star AS INTEGER) AS star , m.archetype , m.arousal_type , CAST(m.family_id AS INTEGER) AS family_id FROM monster m WHERE m.skill_group_id IS NOT NULL AND CAST(m.skill_group_id AS BIGINT) = CAST(#{skill_group_id} AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(m.usg_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY m.monster_elemental, m.monster_id

/* selectMonsterStatCohortBounds - star + awaken digit cohort min/max */ SELECT MIN(m.max_lvl_hp) FILTER (WHERE m.max_lvl_hp IS NOT NULL) AS cohort_min_hp, MAX(m.max_lvl_hp) FILTER (WHERE m.max_lvl_hp IS NOT NULL) AS cohort_max_hp, MIN(m.max_lvl_attack) FILTER (WHERE m.max_lvl_attack IS NOT NULL) AS cohort_min_attack, MAX(m.max_lvl_attack) FILTER (WHERE m.max_lvl_attack IS NOT NULL) AS cohort_max_attack, MIN(m.max_lvl_defense) FILTER (WHERE m.max_lvl_defense IS NOT NULL) AS cohort_min_defense, MAX(m.max_lvl_defense) FILTER (WHERE m.max_lvl_defense IS NOT NULL) AS cohort_max_defense, MIN(m.speed) FILTER (WHERE m.speed IS NOT NULL) AS cohort_min_speed, MAX(m.speed) FILTER (WHERE m.speed IS NOT NULL) AS cohort_max_speed, MIN(m.crit_rate) FILTER (WHERE m.crit_rate IS NOT NULL) AS cohort_min_crit_rate, MAX(m.crit_rate) FILTER (WHERE m.crit_rate IS NOT NULL) AS cohort_max_crit_rate, MIN(m.crit_damage) FILTER (WHERE m.crit_damage IS NOT NULL) AS cohort_min_crit_damage, MAX(m.crit_damage) FILTER (WHERE m.crit_damage IS NOT NULL) AS cohort_max_crit_damage, MIN(m.resistance) FILTER (WHERE m.resistance IS NOT NULL) AS cohort_min_resistance, MAX(m.resistance) FILTER (WHERE m.resistance IS NOT NULL) AS cohort_max_resistance, MIN(m.accuracy) FILTER (WHERE m.accuracy IS NOT NULL) AS cohort_min_accuracy, MAX(m.accuracy) FILTER (WHERE m.accuracy IS NOT NULL) AS cohort_max_accuracy, MIN(m.skill_ups_to_max) FILTER (WHERE m.skill_ups_to_max IS NOT NULL) AS cohort_min_skill_ups, MAX(m.skill_ups_to_max) FILTER (WHERE m.skill_ups_to_max IS NOT NULL) AS cohort_max_skill_ups FROM monster m WHERE m.usg_yn = 'Y' AND CAST(COALESCE(m.star, 0) AS INTEGER) = #{star} AND LENGTH(m.monster_id) >= 2 AND SUBSTRING(m.monster_id FROM LENGTH(m.monster_id) - 1 FOR 1) ~ '^[0-9]$' AND CAST(SUBSTRING(m.monster_id FROM LENGTH(m.monster_id) - 1 FOR 1) AS INTEGER) = #{awaken_digit}
